    “Created” is the date a file was added to this Drive. Material copied in from an older folder carries the date it was copied; open “copies” on a row to see earlier locations.

    Made by Ankit Patel - Prepteam 2025-26
    Left out on purpose: anything holding students' personal data (rosters, CVs, form responses with emails or phone numbers, attendance, allocations, GD scores, shortlist and placement status), committee trackers and calendars, recording links with passcodes, and every job description, JAF, job-description form, company brochure, selection case and other company-supplied recruitment document.
    Folder links appear only where everything inside that folder is listed on this page, so opening a folder never shows a file that was left out.
    Duplicate copies of the same file are merged into one row, which links the newest copy and lists the others under “copies”.
